spans.text:
Mark numbers with `[UNVERIFIED]` suffix if they appear only once in an
  informal statement (e.g., "seemed like around 85%").
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes truthfulness and information integrity through multiple mechanisms: confidence levels (high/medium/low), the [UNVERIFIED] suffix for uncertain numbers, recording unclear context, and preserving all values with their contexts rather than cherry-picking. It explicitly instructs the system to note data quality warnings.

spans.text: Strip all email addresses, real names (if not author labels like "Reviewer 1"),
spans.note: The prompt has explicit and detailed instructions for stripping PII, credentials, API keys, passwords, tokens, and institutional affiliations. It includes a tracking field to indicate when PII has been removed and categorically prohibits including credentials in output.
